keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Cihan Kahraman (Académico de Viseu) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Stavros Gavriel (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, CD Nacional 0, Académico de Viseu 0.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Daniel Júnior replaces Stavros Gavriel.
João Guilherme (Académico de Viseu) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury João Guilherme (Académico de Viseu).
Delay in match because of an injury Markus Jensen (CD Nacional).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Robinho (Académico de Viseu) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Matchoi Djaló replaces Miguel Baeza.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Alejandro Mestanza replaces Cihan Kahraman.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Álvaro Zamora replaces João Guilherme.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Lorougnon Gohi replaces Nils Mortimer.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Deivison replaces Markus Jensen.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Danel Dongmo replaces Chiheb Laabidi.
Anthony Correia (Académico de Viseu) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, CD Nacional. Pablo Ruan replaces Song Min-Kyu.
Zé Vítor (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! CD Nacional 1, Académico de Viseu 0. Matchoi Djaló (CD Nacional) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pablo Ruan with a cross.
Matheus Dias (CD Nacional) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Mohamed Bouldini replaces Soufiane Messeguem.
Second Half ends, CD Nacional 1, Académico de Viseu 0.
